prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent modular character sprite atlas for Lull, a calm tactile children's toy for ages 2–6.
Create a landscape atlas of THREE DIFFERENT handmade felt friends, in THREE COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, all isolated on a truly transparent background. Column 1 a warm ivory rabbit with long ears, column 2 a soft cinnamon bear with round ears, column 3 a dusty blue songbird with a small ochre beak. Row 1: their separate heads only, front facing, chin flat at the same height. Row 2: their separate short rounded torsos and arms only, with a clean flat top neckline and flat bottom waist. Rabbit torso: sage knitted cardigan; bear torso: muted terracotta pinafore with one large pocket; bird torso: dusty blue felt belly with a cream oval bib and small wings. Row 3: their separate short legs and two feet only, attached together at a flat wide top waist seam; rabbit cream paws with sage trouser tops, bear cinnamon paws with terracotta trouser tops, bird two ochre feet with dusty blue short legs.
This is ONE interoperable mix-and-match doll set: same size heads, same size torsos, same width top seam on every leg piece; each head can fit on any torso, and any torso can fit on any legs. Parts should touch seamlessly when assembled. Uniform camera: straight-on orthographic; same soft light from upper left. No perspective, no turning, no floor shadows, no room, no base, no separators, no text, no labels. Leave generous clear transparent gaps BETWEEN all nine separate parts, no overlap, no extra whole characters. Each cell occupies exactly one third of width and one third of height, centered in its cell. Use large cell filling artwork, leaving 8% padding each side.
Style: premium stop-motion wool felt dolls, fine matte wool fibers, plump rounded forms, friendly small black bead eyes with one subtle highlight, gentle smiles, softly blushed cheeks. Warm cream, sage, clay and dusty blue palette, restrained charming detail. All painted material must be fully opaque, including dark blue edges and fibers: no eaten-away speckles, holes, ragged transparent patches or keyed color contamination. Clean alpha antialiasing only at the exterior silhouette. NO checkerboard baked into image. Flat neck and waist mating seams matter more than embellishment.
